# VitalScale Digital

> Your care is real. Make sure your paperwork and your page show it. Nurse-led NDIS policies, social media and websites for NDIS providers in Australia, with safe AI and chatbots as an add-on. Founded by Ajay Singh, a Registered Nurse. Start free with a week of posts or a personalised website demo, or start your policies with the $166 Gap Check. Prices include GST, with no hidden costs and no promises of registration or audit outcomes.

## Key facts

- Founded and run by Ajay Singh, a Registered Nurse, based in Melbourne, Victoria. Clients deal with Ajay directly, from the first chat to the finished work.
- Works with NDIS providers across Australia.
- ABN 28 337 767 445.
- Every price includes GST. Every job has a fixed written quote before work starts, and nothing is added without the client's written OK.
- We will never change our bank details by email. If in doubt, call us.
- Monthly plans (Scroll-stopping Social Media and the Website Care Plan) have no lock-in: cancel anytime with 30 days' notice.
- Never promises NDIS registration or audit results, and doesn't act as an auditor: audits must be done by an approved quality auditor.
- Safe AI rules: only Australian-hosted tools that don't train on client data, no participant information in public chatbots, and staff check and sign off everything AI drafts. VitalScale never holds participants' information.
- The NDIS changes on the home page are checked against official NDIS sources every Monday.
- Three ways to start, one for each service: a free week of posts (social media), a free personalised website demo (websites) and the $166 Policy vs Practice Gap Check (policies). The two free starts cost nothing, need no card and come with no obligation. The $166 Online Trust Check is also available. The full $166 of a check comes off if the client goes ahead within 30 days.
- Phone and WhatsApp: 0406 970 615 (+61 406 970 615).

## Start here

- [Start here](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/start): the three ways to start, side by side.
- [Free week of posts](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/free-week): we design one week of social media posts for an NDIS business (3 single-image posts and 1 carousel), with captions written for families and support coordinators. The provider uploads them. Free, one per business, no obligation.
- [Free personalised website demo](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/free-demo): a homepage designed for an NDIS business (services, area and how to refer), shown on a computer and a phone. A demo, not a full website. Free, no obligation. Logo, colours and brand design are also available.
- [Policy vs Practice Gap Check](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/policy-check), $166 inc GST: a Registered Nurse compares up to 5 policies with how the team actually works, and the provider gets a written gap report and a 30-minute call. No participant information is ever needed.
- [$166 checks](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/checks): the Policy vs Practice Gap Check ($166 inc GST: a written gap report plus a 30-minute call) and the Online Trust Check ($166 inc GST: a video walkthrough, a 1-page checklist and a 20-minute call).
- [Pricing](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/pricing): one starting price per service, all including GST, with what's included, what isn't, ongoing support and the reports clients get.

## Services and prices (all including GST)

- [Policy + Evidence System](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/ndis-policies-and-procedures), from $1,755: only the policies a provider actually needs, written from a call about how the team really works (no templates), with an evidence map, one-page staff guides, an audit pack index and a change log.
- [Scroll-stopping Social Media](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/ndis-marketing), from $1,423 a month: a 2-hour scripted content shoot at the workplace every month and 5 posts a week on Instagram and Facebook, with a monthly check on enquiries and messages, not likes, and a profile clean-up on Instagram and Facebook. Branding photos add-on: $214. Add-ons: Google Business Profile setup $330, WhatsApp Business setup $330, both $500; optional monthly management $166 a month each, no lock-in.
- [NDIS Website](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/ndis-website-design), from $1,380: every page planned around what participants, families and support coordinators look for. Website Care Plan: $166 a month for hosting, updates and small edits. Branding or rebranding add-on (logo, colours and brand design): $288. Website extras (AI chatbot, accessibility tools, online booking, extra languages, extra pages) are priced in writing before work starts.
- [Safe AI and chatbots](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/safe-ai-for-ndis-providers): an add-on to any service, priced in the proposal. Chatbots for WhatsApp, Facebook, Instagram or a website that can answer in Punjabi, Hindi or English; a person always checks, and no participant health information is collected.

## Free resources

- [NDIS policy checklist](https://vitalscaledigital.com.au/ndis-policy-checklist): a free checklist of the policies NDIS providers need, registered or unregistered, with what an auditor wants to see and the official source for each item. Checked against official sources on 3 November 2026.
